descriptions.w3d_d27a_grid_probe_ground_8001e7e0: Starts the low bound from the given y and the high bound from the floor at +108. Traces from four offsets of the footprint width at +104 up to 1000 units. Returns 0 if a hit is above the given y minus half of 0x804aa790. Tracks the low and high hits. A miss, or a hit below the floor, sets the flag to 1 and returns 1. Slopes rejected by 0x8014c7fc give flag 2. Returns 1.
